feeds.what: all federal contests (US Senate, both US House districts), statewide/district totals
feeds.notes: WCF JSON service behind the site's maps: {"d":[ one object per candidate per race ]}. raceID=0 returns every race of that type; a specific raceID (e.g. 450000000004069 = US Senate) returns one. osn and party must be 0 for a general election (osn=1000 or party= empty returned {"d":null}). category=SW gives the race-wide total, category=CTY gives one row per candidate per county (saved example: GetMapData-FED-CTY-ussenate.json, 131873 bytes). 'type' values are the same as the site's menu: FED, PSC, SCJ, JUD, SENATE, HOUSE, BQ.

feeds.what: Public Service Commission, Supreme Court, District Court judges
feeds.notes: Same URL with type=SCJ (1212 bytes, saved GetMapData-SCJ-SW-race0.json) and type=JUD (15598 bytes, saved GetMapData-JUD-SW-race0.json).

feeds.what: turnout and precincts reporting per county, plus the server clock
feeds.notes: One object per county: PrecinctsReporting, TotalPrecincts, PartialPrecincts, Voters, calcVoterTurnout, CurrentDateTime.

feeds.what: candidate/choice list for every contest in the state including local (no votes)
feeds.notes: Used by the site's search box. Fields ID, Party, desc (contest), label, name. No vote counts.

feeds.what: server-rendered HTML results page for a contest group (the same numbers; also where the last-updated stamp and race ids appear)

election_id: The live site serves 'the current election' with no id in the URL (ElectionID=0 in GetCandidates; GetMapData takes no election id). Archived elections use ?eid=<n> on the site and GetMapDataArchive?...&electionID=<n> / GetVoterTurnoutArchive?electionID=<n> on the service (seen in the site's JavaScript, not fetched). Race ids look like 450000000004069; the leading 45 may be this election's number but I did not confirm that.
discovery: No elections-list endpoint found. https://electionresults.mt.gov/ always shows the current election (title on the page: '2026 General Election - November 3, 2026'); a client should read that title to know which election the unversioned service is serving.
cors: * (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * and Access-Control-Allow-Headers: Content-Type on every esersws.mt.gov/ResultsAjax.svc response)
bot_blocking: None. The relay User-Agent got HTTP 200 on electionresults.mt.gov pages and on every esersws.mt.gov service call; a browser UA was not needed.
updated_field: Not in GetMapData (its CurrentDateTime is null). The HTML pages carry 'Results last updated: 11/10/2026 4:15:25 PM MT' (Mountain time). GetVoterTurnoutData has CurrentDateTime '11/10/2026 4:20:27 PM', which is the server's clock at request time, and LastUpdateTime, which was null.
reporting_field: PrecinctsReporting, TotalPrecincts and PrecinctsPartial on every GetMapData row, e.g. "PrecinctsPartial":0,"PrecinctsReporting":728 ... "TotalPrecincts":728 for US Senate.
choice_format: One JSON object per candidate: "PartyCode":"REP","PartyName":"Republican", ... "RaceName":"UNITED STATES SENATOR", ... "calcCandidate":"KURT ALME","calcCandidatePercentage":0.48125122581066948,"calcCandidateVotes":235559. Names are upper case; party codes seen: REP, DEM, LIB, IND, NON. Measures: calcCandidate "Yes" / "No" with empty PartyCode; judicial retention uses "YES" / "NO". Write-ins are not reported on this site (the site says so).
district_field: Both. RaceName carries it ('STATE REPRESENTATIVE DISTRICT 55', 'UNITED STATES REPRESENTATIVE 2ND CONGRESSIONAL'), AreaNum carries a padded label ('HD 055', 'SD 08', '2ND CONGRESSIONAL', 'Montana' for statewide), and OfficeSeqNo encodes it numerically (8055 = HD 55, 7014 = SD 14, 2002 = CD 2, 1000 = US Senate).
terms: none found. The footer says: 'Election Night Results Reporting is a free service provided by the Office of Montana Secretary of State Christi Jacobsen in cooperation with Montana's Clerks & Recorders and Election Administrators.' (https://electionresults.mt.gov/ResultsExport.aspx). Only a general privacy policy is linked (http://mt.gov/1240-X06.pdf, not fetched).
tried: curl https://electionresults.mt.gov/ with the relay UA: 200, BPro TotalVote layout (resultsSW.aspx, ResultsExport.aspx).

ResultsExport.aspx: offers 'Statewide Export', 'Legislative Export' and one export per county, but each is an ASP.NET __doPostBack (a form POST with __VIEWSTATE). I did not submit it, because the brief forbids submitting forms; so the export's format is not confirmed.
Read the page scripts: ServiceRoot = 'https://esersws.mt.gov/', methods ResultsAjax.svc/GetCandidates, GetMapData, GetMapDataArchive, GetVoterTurnoutData, GetVoterTurnoutArchive.
GetMapData with osn=1000&party= (as written in the HTML onclick): {"d":null}. With osn=0&party=0 (what CreateMap.js sends for a General): real rows.
GetMapData with raceID=0: returns every race of the type, so 7 GETs (FED, PSC, SCJ, JUD, SENATE, HOUSE, BQ) cover all 146 state-level contests.
